text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 200, "unit": "students", "kind": "count", "span": "A class of 200 students"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 3, "unit": "groups", "kind": "count", "span": "split into 3 groups"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 10, "unit": "students", "kind": "count", "span": "the last one (which is the smallest) is 10 less than each of the other groups"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "if the smallest group were as big as the others the class total would be 10 larger"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "that levelled total split into 3 groups gives the size of each equal group"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "the smallest group is 10 less than an equal group"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many students are in the smallest group"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 2, "reason": "'2 of them are equal in number' says which groups match; it is not a quantity to combine"}, {"value": 1, "reason": "'the last one' is an ordinal naming the third group"}]}
